revisions.title: Defining knowledge by naming its instances
revisions.body: Keep the question at the level of a definition, not a catalogue. Theaetetus first offers craft-knowledges such as shoemaking and carpentry, but Socrates asks for the one thing knowledge itself is, not its many instances.
